terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run uvicorn shiro_mlops.service.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: FastAPI forecasting service on :8000 (OpenAPI docs at /docs)

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: React 19 + Vite dashboard on :5173 (proxies /api to the API on :8000)

terminals.name: dagster
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && DAGSTER_HOME="$PWD/.dagster_home" uv run dagster dev -f src/shiro_mlops/pipelines/definitions.py -h 0.0.0.0 -p 3000
